guidebook.page.building.overview.body1: BuildScape adds **hundreds of new building blocks** including colored tiles, mosaic glass, sandstones in every color, concrete stairs/slabs, and much more. All blocks integrate seamlessly with vanilla Minecraft.
guidebook.page.building.slabs.body1: Most BuildScape blocks come with matching **slab, stair, and wall** variants â€” including *vertical* slab and stair variants for more creative freedom.
guidebook.page.building.slabs.body2: Vertical slabs are placed by right-clicking the **side face** of an existing block, or by sneaking while placing.
guidebook.page.building.glass.body1: BuildScape adds **16 colors of Mosaic Glass and Panes**, matching every standard dye color. Mosaic glass has a stained-glass look with a geometric pattern overlay â€” perfect for decorative windows.
guidebook.page.nature.flowers.body1: BuildScape expands vanilla flora with **colored rose vines**, Monet flowers in multiple shades, petal items, and Frost Roses. These can be composted and used as decoration.
guidebook.page.nature.flowers.caption: Rose Vines â€” use as climbing decoration.
guidebook.page.nature.snowy.body1: All vanilla tall-grass, fern, and leaf types have **snowy variants** that spawn naturally in cold biomes and can be silk-touch harvested.
guidebook.page.nature.snowy.body2: Snowy plants can be composted and contribute to the natural feel of winter builds.
guidebook.page.nature.spore.body1: BuildScape adds **5 new Spore Blossom colors** (Red, Cyan, Blue, Purple, Orange) that hang from ceilings and emit falling particle effects matching their color.
guidebook.page.nature.mushroom.body1: **Brown and Red Mushroom Shelves** are decorative shelf blocks styled after mushroom caps. They can be composted and pair well with rustic builds.
guidebook.page.deco.frames.body1: BuildScape allows vanilla item frames to be made **invisible** â€” the frame border disappears, leaving only the floating item. Craft with a vanilla item frame surrounded by glass panes.
guidebook.page.deco.frames.body2: Works with Glow Item Frames too!
guidebook.page.deco.hedges.body1: **Leaf Hedge blocks** make a satisfying rustling sound as you walk across them, using custom step sounds. They function as full solid blocks but with a leafy appearance.
guidebook.page.deco.clover.body1: Small **Clover** plants that grow in meadow and plains biomes. They are purely decorative but add great ground-cover detail to natural builds.
guidebook.page.worldgen.overview.body1: BuildScape adds several world-generation features including new tree types, natural flower spawning, and biome-appropriate ground cover.
guidebook.page.worldgen.overview.body2: Features can be controlled via the **Others** tab in the BuildScape config screen.
guidebook.page.worldgen.leafdecay.body1: Enable **Fast Leaf Decay** via the gamerule `creativeTreeBreaker` or the BuildScape config. When active, leaves decay almost instantly after a tree is felled â€” great for survival chopping efficiency.
